exercises.title: Pass Counter
exercises.description: Count how many scores meet a minimum score threshold.
requirements: Create count_at_least(scores, threshold).
Return an integer count.
Do not modify the input list.
Treat a score equal to the threshold as qualifying.
hints: You can use a counter or sum a generator of ones.
exercises.learning_outcome: Use conditions and loops to count records matching a criterion.

exercises.title: Category Frequency
exercises.description: Build a frequency dictionary for a list of text labels.
requirements: Create count_labels(labels).
Return a dictionary mapping each unique label to its count.
Preserve labels exactly as supplied; do not change capitalization.
Return an empty dictionary for an empty list.
hints: Use counts.get(label, 0) to retrieve a label's current count.
Increase the count by one for each occurrence.
exercises.learning_outcome: Use dictionaries to summarize categorical data.
